master: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE NEW clean pixel-art game sprite master of Lumine (female Traveler), based on image 1 for identity, head-to-body proportions, costume, exact sword grip and right-facing three-quarter upright neutral pose. Image 2 is ONLY the project's broad pixel-cluster style reference, NOT proportions or species. Crucial change: actually draw low-resolution pixel art, not an illustration with a pixel filter. Design the whole body on an approximately 64-pixel-high logical grid, enlarged with crisp square nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Strong coherent dark blue-brown 1-logical-pixel outer contour, joined readable masses of pale gold hair, cream-white dress, blue inner cloth, skin and gold accents; around 14 deliberately chosen flat colors, only 2 tones per material. Simplify gold embroidery into a few large recognizable shapes. Face has a clear amber eye; hair flower one clean white/blue cluster. Preserve original normal feminine proportions and original head/body ratio, no chibi and no smaller head. Near hand grips the sword with fingers closed around handle, guard outside hand, blade extends diagonally down-right, fully visible. Both boots planted, legs relaxed. Compact blue trailing ribbons to left. Entire full-body single sprite centered with wide transparent padding, real alpha background, no floor or shadows. Avoid thin decorative internal outlines, tiny separated highlights, dithering, textured shading, smooth gradients, glow, painterly rendering, anti-aliased fine lines, text, frames, multiple poses. Visible pixels must be broad even squares with contiguous flat-color clusters.
